content: sigma.js (v3.0.3 npm) is WebGL rendering + Graphology for graph/layout data structure, mature plugin ecosystem. react-force-graph (v1.48.2 npm) wraps d3-force + WebGL/Canvas/3D, React-friendly. Cosmograph/@cosmograph/react + @cosmograph/cosmos (GPU shader-based force layout, CC-BY-NC-4.0 license - commercial use requires contacting vendor) handles hundreds of thousands of nodes in real time.
